import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the metric data files for analysis
node_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_node.parquet')
container_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_container.parquet')
service_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_service.parquet')
middleware_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_middleware.parquet')
app_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_app.parquet')

# Combine all metrics into a single DataFrame
all_metrics = pd.concat([node_metrics, container_metrics, service_metrics, middleware_metrics, app_metrics], ignore_index=True)

# Convert timestamp to datetime and filter for the specified time range (UTC+8)
all_metrics['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(all_metrics['timestamp'])
start_time = pd.Timestamp('2020-05-29 02:00:00') - pd.Timedelta(hours=8)
end_time = pd.Timestamp('2020-05-29 02:30:00') - pd.Timedelta(hours=8)
filtered_metrics = all_metrics[(all_metrics['timestamp'] >= start_time) & (all_metrics['timestamp'] <= end_time)]

# Load daily metric thresholds
metric_thresholds = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/metric_stats.parquet')

# Identify anomalies by comparing metrics against thresholds
anomalies = []
for metric in filtered_metrics['metric_name'].unique():
    metric_data = filtered_metrics[filtered_metrics['metric_name'] == metric]
    threshold = metric_thresholds[metric_thresholds['metric_name'] == metric]['threshold'].values[0]
    if not metric_data.empty:
        if (metric_data['value'] > threshold).any():
            anomalies.append({'metric_name': metric, 'anomaly_value': metric_data[metric_data['value'] > threshold]['value'].tolist()})

# Return the anomalies found
anomalies
